summary: BMW FS Securities LLC filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of asset-backed notes by BMW Vehicle Owner Trust 2026-A. The Trust issued five tranches of Class A notes totaling $1.75 billion, backed by motor vehicle retail installment contracts. The filing includes standard transaction agreements such as receivables purchase agreements, a sale and servicing agreement, and a trust agreement. This is a routine securitization transaction, not a special situation. No merger, acquisition, tender, spin-off, restructuring, or similar corporate event is involved. The filing serves to disclose material agreements per SEC requirements.
